name: Carmelo
source:
An assassin hired by [url=/c12373]Silvio[/url], the vice boss of Oruma Rossa. The later had also the one who turned Carmelo into a werewolf. Carmelo always haunts [url=/c12330]Romeo[/url]. He is a drug addict who can easily pick up a fight with anyone. Carmelo goes berserk every time he's intimidated. He is not very good at thinking.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=306925]Getchu[/url].]
